title: 达利欧：共识早已写进价格里
description:
达利欧讲清楚了一件很多人搞反的事：不是算法让他相信「创意择优」，而是他先想要创意择优，才去用的算法。

他的出发点很朴素——想在市场上赢，你就必须是个独立思考者，敢跟共识对赌，因为共识早就已经反映在价格里了。可问题是，没有谁厉害到能自认掌握全部答案。他说自己是被现实狠狠揍过不少次，才学会了几分谦逊，才承认手里正确答案不够多，所以他想要一群独立思考的人。

那一群独立思考的人吵起来怎么办？这就需要一套创意择优的机制。而算法的妙处在于：你不再纠结此刻要做什么决策，而是去想做这个决策的标准应该是什么；把标准写下来、写清楚、写成算法，你就能拿历史去检验它到底管不管用。

他说这才是真正的成功关键——而且我们现在正处在一个时代，创意择优式的思考可以被系统化，产出比任何个人都更好的结果。

#达利欧 #桥水 #原则 #创意择优 #独立思考 #投资心法

quotes.en: In order to be successful in the markets, you have to be an independent thinker who bets against the consensus, because the consensus is in the price.
quotes.zh: 想在市场上成功，你就必须是一个独立思考者，敢于跟共识对赌，因为共识早就反映在价格里了。

quotes.en: I learned by having the stuffing kicked out of me a fair amount of time. I learned a certain amount of humility.
quotes.zh: 我是被现实狠狠揍过不少次，才学会了几分谦逊。

quotes.en: Rather than think about what decision we were gonna make, we would think about what the criteria for making the decisions would be.
quotes.zh: 我们不去纠结此刻要做什么决策，而是去想：做这个决策的标准到底该是什么。

cues.en: So I would say it the opposite way though.
cues.zh: 不过我得反过来说。

cues.en: It wasn't that that thinking led me to have an idea of meritocracy.
cues.zh: 并不是那套思维方式让我产生了「创意择优」的想法。

cues.en: It was that I wanted to have an idea of meritocracy for other reasons, I'll explain, that then made me use the algorithms
cues.zh: 而是我出于别的原因，本来就想要创意择优——这个我等下解释——这才让我去用算法，

cues.en: to help me do that.
cues.zh: 来帮我实现它。

cues.en: In particular, look, in order to be successful in the markets, you have to be an independent thinker who bets against the consensus
cues.zh: 具体来说，你想在市场上成功，就必须是一个独立思考者，敢于跟共识对赌，

cues.en: because the consensus is in the price.
cues.zh: 因为共识早就已经反映在价格里了。

cues.en: And also, nobody's good enough to know themselves that they can, all the answers.
cues.zh: 而且，没有谁厉害到可以自认为掌握了全部答案。

cues.en: So I learned by having, you know, the stuffing kicked out of me a fair amount of time.
cues.zh: 我是被现实狠狠揍过不少次，才学会这一点的。

cues.en: I learned a certain amount of humility.
cues.zh: 我学会了几分谦逊。

cues.en: And then I knew that I didn't have enough of the right answers.
cues.zh: 然后我才知道，我手里正确的答案并不够多。

cues.en: So I wanted a bunch of independent thinkers.
cues.zh: 所以我想要一群独立思考的人。

cues.en: And so when you get independent thinkers, then how do you get past that?
cues.zh: 可一旦你有了一群独立思考的人，接下来该怎么办？

cues.en: And you're gonna wanna have an idea meritocratic process.
cues.zh: 你就会需要一套创意择优的机制。

cues.en: And then what I found is that algorithms allowed me to do that because rather than think about what decision we were gonna make
cues.zh: 后来我发现，算法正好能帮我做到这件事——因为我们不去纠结此刻要做什么决策，

cues.en: at any point in time, we would think about what the criteria for making the decisions would be.
cues.zh: 而是去想：做这个决策的标准到底该是什么。

cues.en: And then if you write down those criteria and make them clear and then put them in the form of an algorithm,
cues.zh: 然后把这些标准写下来、写清楚，再把它写成算法的形式，

cues.en: then you could test how they would have worked over history.
cues.zh: 你就能拿历史数据去检验：这套标准过去到底管不管用。

cues.en: And that allowed idea meritocratic thinking.
cues.zh: 这就让创意择优式的思考成为可能。

cues.en: And we also had a ways of getting past it.
cues.zh: 我们也有别的办法越过这道坎。

cues.en: I'm sure we'll get into those.
cues.zh: 这些我们后面肯定会聊到。

cues.en: I don't wanna hijack that by explaining those ways.
cues.zh: 我现在就不展开了，免得把话题带偏。

cues.en: But that led us to make, use algorithms to have an idea meritocracy, to make better decisions than any individuals could.
cues.zh: 但正是这条路，让我们用算法做出了创意择优，做出比任何个人都更好的决策。

cues.en: And that's been really the key to the success.
cues.zh: 这才是我们真正成功的关键。

cues.en: It's one of the, it's in the work principles here.
cues.zh: 它也写在这里的《工作原则》里。

cues.en: And it's that one of those things that I really wanna emphasize.
cues.zh: 而这一点，是我特别想强调的。

cues.en: Cause I think we're now in an era in which when we talk about open source and such things, we're now in an era where idea meritocratic thinking
cues.zh: 因为我觉得，我们现在正处在这样一个时代——就像我们谈开源那样——创意择优式的思考，

cues.en: can be then systemized to produce better results than any individual can produce.
cues.zh: 已经可以被系统化，产出比任何个人都更好的结果。
